name: images_pbr_maps
description: Extract named PBR maps with Patina from an owned image. Input images larger than 1 MP are downscaled before processing. One async creation; poll materialMaps on its completed results.

creationIdentifier.description: Owned image identifier; import uploads first.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

maps.description: Default all five. Cost: one base unit plus one per unique map.
